 Monza vs Napoli Prediction, 10/28/2026 Soccer Pick, Tips and Odds
 by Josh Schonwald - 10/26/2026 
 Game: Monza vs Napoli
 Date: Wednesday, October 28, 2026
 Location: U-Power Stadium in Monza, Italy
 TV: DAZN, Paramount+
 Monza (2-1-5) will compete against Napoli (3-2-3) at U-Power Stadium in Monza, Italy on Wednesday. The White and Reds are priced at +110 and the Blues are at -130. The total is 3. The men protecting the net will be Noel Tornqvist for Monza and Alex Meret for Napoli.
 Monza has accumulated 25 saves and they have earned a save rate of 58.1% on the campaign. The team's differential on goals is currently at -3 by means of 15 goals finished as well as 18 goals given up. The White and Reds are 15th in the matter of expected goals having 19.5, and their expected goals against sit at 20.7. Monza has 11 yellow card warnings on the campaign and also 1 red card. A.C. Monza has relinquished 18 goals while allowing 2.25 goals per 90 minutes, and the opposition have accounted for 43 shots on target on them. They are sitting with 1 clean sheet, which has them at a percentage of 12.5% on the year. For the year, the squad averages 0.88 points per match (7 pts) and rank 8th among European teams with 10 assists.

 The Blues average 1.4 points per fixture while totaling 9 assists. Napoli ranks 9th in relation to goals conceded having 10, and the squad's goal difference sits at 3. S.S.C. Napoli has a shut out rate of 37.5% this year and 7 yellow cards. So far this year, S.S.C. Napoli has a save % of 67.7% (31 SoTA), and also are 10th among Big 5 teams with 11 pts. The club's goals against per 90 min is currently at 1.25 with 21 saves, and they have 3 clean sheets. Napoli has totaled 13 goals and the squad's xG on the season is 21.0.
 The man who will protect the net for Monza will be Noel Tornqvist. Tornqvist has seen the pitch for 8,725 mins and is sitting with 250 stops so far in his pro soccer career. His goals against per 90 minutes is 0.89 (86 goals given up) and he holds a save percentage of 74.4%. The keeper born in Sweden has had 336 shots attempted against him in 98 career starting assignments. Tornqvist (52-20-26 record in his career) has accounted for 32 clean sheets, which leaves him with a 33.0%% shutout percentage.
 Alex Meret will look after the goal for Napoli. In his career, Meret has allowed 288 goals while tallying 663 stops in 274 starting assignments. He has given up 1.05 goals per 90 mins while holding a mark of 148-64-61. He sports a save % of 69.8% and his clean sheet rate is currently at 33.5%%. Meret has totaled 92 shutouts and defended 950 shots attempted against him in 24,719 mins in his career.
 Patrick Cutrone is one member of the side who should impact this matchup for Monza. He has 20 assists while tallying 164 pts so far in his career. The forward born in Italy has 72 goals scored in 17,378 minutes played. Cutrone has been a starter in 191 contests during his career and has 0.37 goals per 90.
 Napoli features a difference maker in Kevin De Bruyne, who is known to give defenses fits. He has earned 562 points in his pro soccer career and has helped a teammate on a goal 240 times. The midfielder born in Belgium has totaled 48,762 minutes while scoring 161 goals. He scores 0.30 goals per 90 minutes and has been in the starting lineup in 560 games in his pro soccer career.

 Josh Schonwald's Pick: Take Napoli (+110)
